recommendation.canonicalMapping: Reuse CanonicalCatalogIds.productForReviewedSource(BUILDCORES, externalId); resolve existing products by exact source; preserve local UUIDs, specification and PC links.
recommendation.identityPromotion: Do not infer verified sale identity from central membership. V13 permits reviewed canonical ID on LEGACY_UNCLASSIFIED with evidence while modelId remains null and role UNASSIGNED. Retain this safe classification until SKU/model review is complete.
recommendation.prices: Existing reviewed observations may be shared with their original timestamps and freshness. No new observations, zero prices or new stock status may be synthesized.
recommendation.retailScope: Domestic new product price only. Require exact sale SKU and sale unit; RAM kit amount stays per kit. No shipping, coupons or promotion assumptions.
recommendation.missingPrices: Keep distinct pending identity, pending price, and confirmed no available domestic new offer states; a generic search miss is insufficient to assert discontinued or unavailable.
recommendation.monitor: Existing 20 MONITOR products need source-based canonical IDs; catalog_model currently has no monitor model kind, so generic model registration is not available.
